run_setup_environment: run the setup_environment function to initialize the pyslowfast environment once
create_pathmgr: create a path manager instance via PathManagerFactory.get with key pyslowfast for file I/O operations
create_checkpoint_pathmgr: create a checkpoint path manager instance via PathManagerFactory.get with key pyslowfast_checkpoint for checkpoint file I/O
test_setup_environment: test that setup_environment is idempotent and does not re-execute on subsequent calls
review_pathmgr: review the pathmgr and checkpoint_pathmgr PathManagerFactory instances for file access configuration
